seo.title: Backtracking In Three Lines: Choose, Explore, Undo
seo.hook: Three toppings make eight different pizzas. Three lines of code generate every one of them
seo.description: You can generate every combination without duplicates, using one three-line recipe.

scenes.narration: Three toppings make eight different pizzas. Three lines of code generate every one of them.

scenes.headline: Choose, explore, [undo]
scenes.caption: the three-line recipe
scenes.narration: Every combination comes out of one recipe, and the recipe is three lines. |Current dot append puts a topping on. Call that the choose step. |Backtrack calls itself and builds every pizza that starts this way. Call that explore. |And current dot pop takes the topping back off. Call that the undo. ^Choose, ^explore, ^undo. Say that out loud a few times, because every backtracking problem you'll ever meet is those three lines wrapped around a different rule.

lines.detail: EXPLORE: build everything that starts this way.

scenes.premise: Building pizzas from three toppings. Each node is the pizza so far — going down adds a topping, coming back up takes it off again.

scenes.headline: Down the [first branch]
scenes.caption: pepperoni, then mushroom
scenes.narration: |We put pepperoni on, so the pizza is ^one, and we photograph it. Notice the call is diving rather than spreading, because it isn't looking at the other toppings yet at all. |Backtrack calls itself from the next topping along, mushroom goes on too, the pizza is ^one and two, and +another photograph is taken. Backtrack goes as deep as the branch allows before considering anything else.

lines.detail: Dive: what else can sit on a pepperoni pizza?

scenes.premise: Building pizzas from three toppings. Each node is the pizza so far — going down adds a topping, coming back up takes it off again.

scenes.headline: The bottom, and the [way back]
scenes.caption: undo, one topping at a time
scenes.narration: Olive goes on, the pizza is ^one two three, the supreme, +photographed. No toppings are left to try, so the loop ends and the call returns upward. |Current dot pop takes olive back off, and we're at ^one two again. That loop has also finished, so |that call returns too, and pop takes mushroom off, leaving ^just pepperoni. We've climbed back up two levels, and now the loop at that level can carry on to the topping it never got to.
